Members

(module scope)

Structural surface the Safari patches rely on (BaseComponent subclasses).

(module scope)

The slice of a component prototype the patches may re-bind — every member is optional because a patch only touches the methods Safari actually breaks (e.g. media-figure's high-res load path).

(module scope)

A custom-element constructor whose prototype exposes the patchable methods.
